name: usage-meter
description: Show a quota ring and reset-time title on the native Usage Meter sidebar entrypoint.

interface.shortDescription: A quota ring for the ChatGPT sidebar
interface.longDescription: The sidebar entrypoint advertises a bold quota ring with a local reset-date caption. Its title includes full reset times and the reading timestamp. The icon supports monochrome host rendering. Updated metadata uses official MCP change notifications.
defaultPrompt: Open Usage Meter and show my current usage limits.
